trigger: a RHEL-family host whose agent account cannot list /etc/pki/entitlement (or holds an oversized/unparseable .pem) upgrades to this build; rollback to the previous build
classification_rationale: the breaking behaviour change (the whole daily licence sync is paused for the host, all licence rows freeze) has no Breaking lead, no user-manual text and no upgrading.md entry
summary: The Linux licence-sync behaviour change (a refused/unreadable /etc/pki/entitlement, or an oversized/empty/unparseable .pem, now skips the whole daily licence sync so every licence row of that host keeps its last good value; before, a refused directory read as ok|0 and wiped the entitlement rows while the others flowed; rollback restores the wipe) conceals a breaking change: I7 raised to HIGH. The Architect ruled it adapted: the pause itself was not new for an unreadable/empty/garbage .pem, so the fix states exactly the new consequences (refused directory, .pem over 64 KiB, rollback).

trigger: the branch changes C++ and carries no governance.d fragment and no Resource Ledger
policy_floor: missing-governance-ledger (CLAUDE.md 'Agent team & governance': a C++ diff needs the Gate 1 Resource Ledger; SKILL.md contract violation, gates regardless of the derived band)
classification_rationale: a required record (the ledger fragment and its Resource Ledger) is absent, so it contradicts nothing
summary: C++ diff with no governance.d/ fragment and no Resource Ledger row (policy floor).

trigger: the agent cannot list a FlexLM licence directory (ProbeHost::glob uses skip_permission_denied and run_probe_specs defaults the outcome to ok); the same swallow hits mas_receipt on macOS
classification_rationale: the surface reports flexlm_lic|ok|0 where it could not check
summary: A refused FlexLM directory reads flexlm_lic|ok|0, which the sync consumer treats as an authoritative valid-empty and full-replaces to empty. Pre-existing (the ProbeSpec table and glob are untouched by this change); this change fixes the same class only for entitlement_certs. Widening to an errno-aware ProbeSpec glob is its own change.

trigger: rpm is present but its query fails and dpkg-query is absent: run_pkg_metadata_surface falls through to pkg_metadata|ok|0, a primary surface
classification_rationale: a failed enumeration is reported as a valid empty one
summary: pkg_metadata reads ok|0 when rpm is present and failing and dpkg-query is absent; the consumer treats pkg_metadata as primary and full-replaces to empty. Pre-existing (the pkg_metadata surface is unchanged by this diff).

trigger: an ENCRYPTED CERTIFICATE block (Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED) under /etc/pki/entitlement while the agent holds an open stdin pipe: PEM_read_bio_X509 with no callback uses OpenSSL's default prompt, which blocks the worker (measured 4 to 7.7 s)
classification_rationale: the header promises a parse failure for unreadable input; an encrypted block prompts instead
summary: licensing_x509.hpp passes a null password callback; an encrypted block prompts on stdin and blocks. Fix: a no-op pem_password_cb returning 0 plus an ENCRYPTED vector.

trigger: a clean host (every CI runner) runs the typed-status check in test_license_scan_actions.cpp: only the UNDECLARED arm executes, which a deleted propagate_surface_status call also yields
classification_rationale: the comment claims a dropped or mis-wired call fails; that is true only on a host with a failing surface
summary: The test's comment overclaims what it pins. A controlled-ProbeHost test cannot reach propagate_surface_status through the dispatch seam, so the honest fix is to reword; delivery of the typed status through both actions is closed by the real-host refusal probe, not by this test.

trigger: a change of kBplistMaxObjects or kBplistMaxStringBytes moves every boundary test with it
classification_rationale: no test pins the numeric policy by literal
summary: Boundary tests derive their limits from the production constants, so loosening a cap fails nothing.

trigger: parse_pem_not_after builds a std::string and push_backs into a vector, either of which can throw std::bad_alloc, while its comment says 'Never throws'
classification_rationale: a comment contradicting the code is a truth finding
summary: 'Never throws' is false for allocation failure. The ERR-queue sentence was re-checked against the code and passes.

trigger: durable files carry the roadmap programme tag and history comments ('as it always has', 'replaces the 60 s gate')
classification_rationale: roadmap ids and change-history phrasing do not belong in durable files
summary: Remove the roadmap tag from code comments, test headers, the fixture README, the tests/meson.build comments and the spawn-sink manifest; reword the two history phrases. The Architect adapted the fix: the fixture README keeps its host and OS build string, because exact-build provenance is the repo's fixture convention (tests/unit/fixtures/wave7/autoruns/macos/README.md).

trigger: read_file_capped's comment says every consumer reads an admin/root-owned tree, but /Applications is root:admin 775, so a local admin can link Contents/Info.plist elsewhere
classification_rationale: the comment overstates the trust in the read tree
summary: Reword to the real trust boundary; the 4 MiB cap and the regular-file check already bound what a followed link costs.

trigger: the curated capability-matrix cell for the macOS leg reads as full identity and version coverage with no measurement scope
classification_rationale: the cell omits version and the measurement scope (euid 501 only; no root-side run)
summary: Reword the curated cell to identity/version, XML and binary, measured at euid 501 against plutil, vendor plists presence-only, receipt unvalidated. SUPPORTED stays per the owner's ruling.

trigger: an upgraded fleet's first sync after this change
classification_rationale: four normal-caller row changes are not stated
summary: The fragment omitted: a multi-certificate .pem now yields up to 16 rows (the openssl runs read only the first), Linux rows are sorted by file name (one hash-skip miss), an XML Info.plist is read up to 4 MiB (a 256 KiB prefix before) and a non-regular Info.plist falls back to the bundle name.

trigger: an operator reads docs/user-manual/software-licensing.md after a refused entitlement directory
classification_rationale: a shipped behaviour change has no user-manual text
summary: The manual does not say a refused entitlement directory or certificate pauses the daily sync. Echoed by consistency-auditor C5.

trigger: a permanently refused entitlement directory: pkg_metadata and FlexLM rows freeze too (before, ok|0 let them flow while wiping the entitlement rows)
classification_rationale: the wording said 'keeps last good' but not that every licence row of the host freezes
summary: Widen the wording; a server-visible 'licence sync skipped' signal is a separate follow-up.

trigger: a skipped licence sync cycle: only an agent log warning records it and nothing on the server marks it
classification_rationale: no operator-visible signal exists for a paused sync, and the agent warning does not name the surface
summary: Add a server-visible 'licence sync skipped' signal and name the surface and error in the agent warning. Out of this change (agents/core and the server are outside its scope).

trigger: README generated fences, docs/os-capability-matrix.md generated rows and content/plugin-docs/license_scan.json still describe the openssl CLI and an undecoded bplist
classification_rationale: generated documentation contradicts the code until it is regenerated
summary: Staleness is by design this round: all generated surfaces regenerate in one plugin_doc_gen and capmatrix pass after the Linux, macOS and Windows captures. Echoed by consistency-auditor C1/C2, architect F2 and enterprise-readiness ER-5.

trigger: a .pem over 64 KiB, or a 0-byte or junk-prefixed .pem, under /etc/pki/entitlement: a parse failure on an authoritative surface freezes the whole host's licence sync every cycle
classification_rationale: the error text does not say 'too large' and the real RHEL entitlement size is unmeasured
summary: chaos-injector recommended a distinct non-blocking token for per-file junk or oversized .pem. Not adopted.

trigger: ENOTDIR or a dangling link at /etc/pki/entitlement reads as absent (ok|0); the oversized-file error text does not say 'too large'; the real RHEL entitlement PEM size is unmeasured
classification_rationale: hardening decisions with no measurement behind them yet
summary: Tighten the absent classification to ENOENT only, make the oversized token diagnosable and measure real RHEL PEM sizes.

trigger: PEM_read_bio_X509 with a null callback elsewhere: agents/plugins/certificates/src/certificates_x509.hpp:294 and agents/core/src/agent_csr.cpp:105
classification_rationale: same defect class as the fixed sec-1, in code this change does not touch
summary: Sweep the sibling PEM readers for the stdin password prompt.

trigger: a certificate or Info.plist reached through a followed link onto a stalled network mount pins a worker with no deadline (the old openssl child had a 20 s kill)
classification_rationale: no deadline exists on an in-process blocking read; the README discloses it
summary: Same shape as the runtimes plugin's disclosed residual; recorded on that issue rather than a new one.

trigger: std::bad_alloc from a new thrower unwinds across the plugin ABI entry point
classification_rationale: the SDK-wide plugin trampoline has no try/catch
summary: Optional: add a try/catch at the plugin ABI entry; SDK-wide, pre-existing.

trigger: mas_receipt rows follow the raw directory_iterator order
classification_rationale: informational; nothing consumes the order
summary: Pre-existing, informational.

trigger: the chmod-0 cases WARN-and-return at euid 0 and read as passes
classification_rationale: the repo precedent (test_shares_posix_fs.cpp) uses the same WARN shape
summary: Prefer SKIP over WARN at euid 0.

trigger: the committed binary Info.plist fixtures could be altered by line-ending normalisation
classification_rationale: no .gitattributes entry pins the fixtures as binary
summary: Optional: add '*.Info.plist binary' to .gitattributes.
